purpose: Early evidence-backed decomposition and calibrated issue effort; a constituent of the governed-intake producer, not another issue tracker or model catalog.

evidence.independence: distinct model family AND distinct provider; exact router and serving receipts required
evidence.graphAuthority: Code shared decomposition core; consume its validated current graph receipt, do not reimplement graph adjudication

effortRubric.subject: Remaining implementation/investigation AND necessary verification relative to a competent, appropriately equipped agent; record aggregate parent work separately.

definitions.low: A known bounded mechanical or local correction with little design judgment or unresolved diagnosis and direct scoped verification. Each condition needs evidence.
definitions.medium: Cohesive bounded implementation, refactor or investigation within an established architecture; meaningful coding and testing or limited diagnosis, without demonstrated deep design or coupled-correctness difficulty.
definitions.high: Demonstrated substantial design or causal reasoning, novel algorithmic work, difficult coupled invariants or complex verification. A genuinely large multi-stage programme may have high aggregate effort, not inherited by its leaves.

rules: Decompose to meaningful executable work units, not until every issue appears easy.
Difficulty and decomposability are independent; certified high-effort atomic leaves remain high.
Size the remaining scope, not completed work or a historical filing.
Missing evidence is unknown, not low and not an invented high conclusion. Escalate material uncertainty and keep unresolved obligations pending.
Distinguish unknowns that prevent assessing scope from implementation unknowns inside an already-classified high-effort task; triage must not require solving the implementation to certify its scope.
A different model, thinking setting, host, quota, waiting time, token count, number of diagnostics, file count or line count alone cannot change effort.
One repository, one PR, shared context or sequential dependencies alone proves neither atomicity nor low effort.
Prevention RCA is not an unconditional medium-effort or indivisibility classification. Conditional examples are not keyword classifiers.
Aggregate parent effort is not an ordinal sum and never sets every child capability floor.
Reuse accepted sizing on unchanged scope, rubric and evidence. Corrections cite new evidence or a violated rubric clause; lowering a high classification requires qualified adjudication.
An atomic issue may contain a plan, checkpoints, multiple commits and multiple sessions.

capabilityPolicy.rule: Task-relevant hard floors precede cost, latency, quota and placement. Consumers never infer eligibility from a name, alias, thinking setting or provenance suffix.
capabilityPolicy.noEligibleCapacity: Durable pending/retry using the existing scheduler; never weaker substitution or a forced effort downgrade.
capabilityPolicy.mechanicalAssistance: Below-floor helpers may collect facts or apply deterministic authorized projections of current qualified evidence; they cannot replace judgment or high-effort execution.

concurrency.owner: existing shared issue/work-unit custody and mutation-admission authority
concurrency.rule: Discovery follows unresolved evidence independently of labels and hosts. Write admission still requires current generic custody. Do not implement a decomp-specific lease, TTL, cleaner or service.
concurrency.legacyCleanup: Remove only the retired cosmetic projection; preserve scope, children, effort and historical evidence. Cleanup failure never suppresses discovery.
concurrency.staleWriters: The generic mutation authority must reject effects after custody loss; label absence or an unchanged GitHub snapshot is not write authorization.

migration.rule: Compare stable item IDs and semantic content; reuse unchanged valid evidence. Reevaluate changed results only at their actual dependents, not a speculative whole-checklist reset.

examples.scope: Forward a known missing CLI option using an existing test pattern.
assumptions: Cause and expected behavior are established

examples.scope: One verified import typo generates hundreds of diagnostics.
assumptions: All relevant errors follow from that cause

examples.scope: A bounded deterministic rename with no behavior redesign.
assumptions: Relevant callers and checks are known

examples.scope: Add a feature using an established extension point.
assumptions: Implementation and edge-case tests require meaningful work

examples.scope: Repair an understood lifecycle transition with integration tests.
assumptions: State invariant and mechanism are known

examples.scope: Add a preventive check for a known failure class.
Diagnose and repair a subtle concurrency race preserving one inseparable invariant.
assumptions: Atomic outcome still needs qualified independent confirmation

examples.scope: Redesign a complex algorithm with correctness and performance obligations.
assumptions: Useful decomposition must still be assessed
High refers to aggregate parent work
Canonical executable leaves are independently sized

examples.scope: Same issue waits longer for CI, credentials or host access.
assumptions: Residual scope and evidence did not change

examples.scope: Another triager dislikes the existing label.
Material evidence is inaccessible and sizing cannot be justified.
